releaseNotes.headline: Remote tools recover clearly
releaseNotes.summary: Version 0.2.17 restores the sync service and makes remote AI tool connection states and recovery clearer.

highlights.title: Restored sync service
highlights.detail: Pair remote AI tools and sync normalized limits through the pmrichq.com relay. Existing connections need to be paired again.

highlights.title: Clear connection states
highlights.detail: Loading, no paired tools, saved readings, and service errors each show their own status.

highlights.title: Retry and reconnect
highlights.detail: Retry temporary errors or reconnect a missing saved connection without losing an active link.

highlights.title: Safer connection changes
highlights.detail: Delayed requests cannot restore removed tools or overwrite a newer pairing code.
